blocks.text: THE CHURCH AGES IN PROPHECY— ‘‘God gave a blessing and judgment on these 7 churches. You will find a list of them in Rev. chaps 2-3. One will also note the 7 stars in Christ hand are symbolic of the messengers He sent unto each age!’’ (Rev. 1:20) ‘‘The church age in Ephesus — Paul was the messenger and a few believed him and was sealed away; but a multitude followed Diana, the goddess of that age! — Before the era ended there was over one thousand prostitutes abiding and working out of the pagan temple! — The Romans deified her on one of their coins! — The age ended in apostasy and the worship of a woman. Something on the same order is repeating itself right now and will grow stronger.’’ (Rev. chap. 17) ‘‘The church in Smyrna was the worship of Cybele, a type of Mary and Zeus, the father figure! — This was the age of terrible persecution; but by another messenger God brought out those who believed! — There was image worship then and it will return again in our last age!’’

CONTINUING— ‘‘The church in Pergamos, this was called the seat of Satan! People worshiped a living serpent in the Temple named Aesculapius (other serpents were housed here too). The acts were so terrible in this place they cannot be recorded; but Satan was worshiped in the form of a serpent... Our age is already witnessing a type of this again in various areas! — Still yet God rescued some in that age to Himself and they were sealed away by His Word! Now let’s move on up into history in the next age! The church at Thyatira. They worshiped the false god of Apollo, the sun god, son of Zeus! The age also mentions the Jezebel of false doctrine and springing forth of the papacy! Thyatria means dominating female and produced the worship of Virgin Mary, wherein today will again dominate the masses! It’s appearing now! — Sin abounded everywhere, yet God through His Word and messenger sealed away those who received salvation!’’

CONTINUING— ‘‘Now the 5th age upward in prophetic history, the church in Sardis. The Babylonian concept of mother child worship, Cybele which now is called, Mary and Christ worship! — The papacy allowed so much sin it was unbelievable! Some popes having illegitimate children and etc. This was the age the great reformation broke out, Luther’s revival ushured in Protestantism again! The just shall live by faith and salvation! — Truly a type of wounding of the beast took place by the Word of God! — This will be healed when the apostaste Protestants return again to Rome! And evidentally a physical type will return again too!’’ (Rev. 13:3) ‘‘Plus the Roman Empire will be ‘revived’ again! We see this today in Western Europe and in events occurring in the Middle East! It was an awful age, but God gave great light and saved the true believer! Now coming right on up in prophecy, the church in Philadelphia they worship Baccus, the god of drinking and revelry, actually a type of Nimrod! Yet, God gave a great revival and evangelization started from England into the United States, to the called out ones and many were redeemed! — This was the 6th age of prophecy, the age of brotherly love and compassion. Running right along side of this age appears the last one.’’

CONTINUING— ‘‘Now moving up into modern times, our age, the 7th and last age, the church in Laodicea. ‘‘In this age they worshiped Zeus, father of the gods, one chief of all gods! In that past age it was called the people’s rights and etc. It was the age of science, medicine and

inventions! — This city was destroyed by great earthquakes! Now in prophecy it repeats itself again and ‘in our age’ it’s called Laodicea!’’ (Rev. 3:14) — ‘‘The church becomes so lukewarm He spews it out! This

is the last age and the elect are translated! We can see our modern age of medicine and science is here too! Now like Zeus, was worshiped as the chief of gods, so will the ‘anti-Christ rise’ and be worshiped the same way! The Laodiceans will blend and are part of Rev. chap. 17 joining the mistress of witchcraft and sorcery! The‘queen whore in whom all nations give her tongue, body and soul worship; as she fornicated in idolatry to the world! We also know like the ancient city of Laodicea this age will be destroyed by terrible earthquakes; (also fire) and the cities of the nations fell!’’ (Rev. 16:19)

CONTINUING— Added information — ‘‘All 7 of these church ages were a group originating at about the time John wrote on Patmos, they were located in Asia Minor.’’ (Rev. 1:4, 11) ‘‘And they have repeated again up through history unto our time! We will now name the messengers to each age taken from history! — We know Paul was the messenger to Ephesus, the first church age. — To the second age was, Irenaeus — The third age was, Martin. — The 4th age Columba. — The Sth age Luther, the reformation! (occurred 1517 A.D.) — The 6th age Wesley — Now the last the 7th age (our age) started about 1903-1906. — Will end by or before the turning of the century! The age of the latter rain appearing now!... ‘‘Also this last age (right at the end) has a messenger too. He will be a prophet with all type Scriptural gifts, including a definite prophetic spirit! He will understand the heavens (Job. 38:33) similar to (the wise men) a magi, (Matt 2:1-11,12) He will believe Jesus is the Eternal God! (Isa. 9:6) — He will have a powerful Word anointing, and will prepare the people for Translation giving them the greatest of insight into mysteries and revelation of the Scriptures, etc.... The chariots of God (lights) will be seen in his locale! The Capstone seal of God will be upon his work!’’

THE MAGNETIC SCROLLS— futuristic — ‘‘The Bible mentions rolls, parchments, seals and books! But only in two places is the word scroll mentioned, and for a definite reason! And in both places it depicts and foretells the very end of the age for our time!’’ — Once in Isa. 34:4, “Wherein it says the host of heaven shall be dissolved, (stars & etc) and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll... Now the next place, Rev.6:14, and the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places! — Vrs. 12-13, ‘‘also shows the host of heaven dissolved, like Isa. stated! — Now once again in our age Scrolls are being used to show among other things prophetic events. And the Scrolls are proclaiming the end of the age again! — And that it will end in desolation and destruction! And it will all transpire in our generation!”’

THE DECADE— ‘‘The world is headed for the greatest upheavals, tumults it has ever seen. Plus nature will teach this planet a lesson it has not witnessed before, quakes, weather & etc. Also the most devastation of famines, wherein babies will be snatched from the mother’s breast for food! — Plus bark, roots on the trees stripped for eatables! Such a severe shortage! Only Rev. 11:6 can match drought of what has been revealed, and Rev. 6:5-8. — Such horrors shall not be prevented! — Including atomic war, billions will die! — The Scripts will be proven correct! — Plus people cannot believe the tremendous changes that will occur in the 90’s. Most people will have to see it to believe it! — Many things planned are hidden (by the government, financial leaders & etc.), but will suddenly come to the forefront! — We are entering the age of sorcery science too! Also mankind will begin to believe they are evolving into some kind of gods; so will need a pagan god to worship in a fantasy world of strong delusion!”’ I might add that we should also know more about the USA economic situation by 1992. We will be explaining more on this in the near future!”’

EVENT 1990— ‘‘Jesus said, not only would there be signs in the heavens, but there would be signs in the moon!”’ (Luke 21:25) And the astronomers are anticipating the two super full moons to occur December 2, and December 31, 1990. And are called this because they are full and will be at their closest approach to the earth this year! When this occurred before preceding and with it events happened in nature, weather, quake, society and also (heaven and earth occurrences) — ‘‘I did not study this for any special significance but one might want to watch and see how the end of the year closes out!’’

WORLD DELUSION— ‘‘Our church age is closing out... Here are some interesting facts wherein the visions of the Virgin Mary are sweeping the nations and will continue! — Fact one — ‘‘Mary’s so called magical appearance in Guadalupe, and they list others.’’ Quote: ‘‘The incredible happenings at San Damiano, including photos of Mary stops the ‘falling sun’. — The amazing wonders at Garabandal, which have been captured on film and cannot be explained. — In California a statue of her is said to have moved under its own power down the church isle to the altar! The pictures show a mysterious light above her. No doubt some of these things are occurring, but they are in a false system! — Now concerning her Fatima visions, she claimed people should all return back into the church in obedience... She told them great destruction (terrible war) was coming but not at that time, but in the last half of this century! — She warned of the ‘silent bomb’ that can kill all! Of course the ‘neutron bomb’ can do this with radiation! ... In another appearance in the middle 80’s she said, she was going to bring peace to all the world; that all must unite as one! — Of course, Satan knows part of the future and will use it for his own benefit! Now in this article it offered authentic water from the shrine of Fatima! In Portugal millions flock for miracles! They offer the world’s most beautiful crystal rosary, and the Fatima good luck medallion, etc. This is all leading into Rev. 17:1-5 and forerunning the coming of the anti- Christ. — Watch and pray! — Jesus said, as a snare shall it take the earth!””
